newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-NIKIFOROV RETURNS FOR RUSSIA AGAINST ISRAEL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIKIFOROV RETURNS FOR RUSSIA AGAINST ISRAEL.

text.p: Sporting Gijon's Yuri Nikiforov will return from suspension to bolster a strong defensive line-up in the Russian side to face group five leaders Israel in next week's World Cup qualifier in Moscow.

Knowing a win is vital to keep alive hopes of France '98, coach Boris Ignatyev named a squad on Friday that also includes the return of Nikiforov's old Spartak Moscow team mate Ramiz Mamedov and 30-year-old Alania back Akkrik Tsveiba, a veteran of 25 Soviet caps who has been out of the squad for years.
He may cover for Roma's Omari Tetradze, who badly damaged ligaments during the 3-0 win over Luxembourg in Moscow in April and will be out for six months.
Two points behind Israel and wary of third-placed Bulgaria, the Russians cannot afford the lapses of defensive concentration that cost them a 1-1 draw in Tel Aviv last October.
"A draw with Israel, far less defeat, is out of the question. We've no room for manoeuvre," spokesman Yuri Yudin said.
In front of the defence, there are fewer changes.
Racing Santander's Vladimir Beschastnykh and Reggiana's Igor Simuntenkov look set to lead the attack, with Sporting's Dmitry Cheryshev and Rotor Volgograd's Oleg Veretennikov also recalled.
Andrei Kanchelskis of Fiorentina is out injured, as is inspirational captain and playmaker Ilya Tsymbalar.

There is still no place for Bologna's Igor Kolyvanov, who scored the equaliser in Tel Aviv but was dropped along with Spanish-based pair Alexander Mostovoy and Valery Karpin for lacking commitment during a shock 1-1 draw in Cyprus.

Spartak Moscow winger Andrei Tikhonov, Russia's 1996 Player of the Year, also wins a place after injury. But it is not clear that Tikhonov, who last weekend played his first half hour of league football in six months, is fit enough to play.
Goalkeepers - Stanislav Cherchesov (Tirol Innsbruck), Sergei Ovchinnikov (Lokomotiv Moscow), Platon Zakharchyuk (Rotor Volgograd).

Defenders - Ramiz Mamedeov (Spartak Moscow), Dmitry Popov (Compostela), Igor Chugaynov (Lokomotiv Moscow), Yuri Nikiforov (Sporting Gijon), Akhrik Tsveiba (Alania Vladikavkaz), Dmitry Khlestov (Spartak Moscow), Yuri Kovtun (Dynamo Moscow).

Midfielders - Sergei Grishin (Dynamo Moscow), Valery Yesipov (Rotor Volgograd), Vladislav Radimov (Zaragoza), Viktor Onopko (Oviedo), Dmitry Alenichev (Spartak Moscow), Alexei Kosolapov (Lokomotiv Moscow), Oleg Veretennikov (Rotor Volgograd), Andrei Tikhonov (Spartak Moscow), Yevgeny Kharlachev (Lokomotiv Moscow).
Forwards - Igor Simutenkov (Reggiana), Vladimir Beschastnykh (Racing Santander), Dmytry Cheryshev (Sporting Gijon), Denis Zubko (Rotor Volgograd).
